# DeployHQ.com

> All public pages on this site support content negotiation. Set the `Accept: text/markdown` header on any URL below to receive clean Markdown instead of HTML. Agent discovery files: [ai-plugin.json](https://www.deployhq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json), [agent.json](https://www.deployhq.com/.well-known/agent.json)

## Tools
- [PageSpeed by DeployHQ](https://pagespeed.deployhq.com/): Web performance testing tool
- [PR Radar by DeployHQ](https://www.deployhq.com/features/pr-radar.md): Free open-source Chrome extension — pull request dashboard for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket with CI status, review tracking, merge controls, and deployment visibility


## Main Features
- [Features Overview](https://www.deployhq.com/features.md): Core features and capabilities of DeployHQ
- [Automatic Deployment](https://www.deployhq.com/features/automatic-deployments.md): Set up automated deployments with DeployHQ
- [Build Cache](https://www.deployhq.com/features/build-cache.md): Lock-file-aware dependency caching that cuts cold build times from minutes to seconds
- [Build Pipelines](https://www.deployhq.com/features/build-pipelines.md): Configure build processes with DeployHQ
- [Custom Actions](https://www.deployhq.com/features/custom-actions.md): Run any Docker container in the deploy pipeline — curated templates for AWS CLI, Terraform, and kubectl, or bring your own image
- [Deploy Behind Firewalls](https://www.deployhq.com/features/deploy-behind-firewalls.md): Deploy to protected environments with DeployHQ
- [DeployHQ AI](https://www.deployhq.com/features/ai.md): AI-powered deployment intelligence, summaries, and risk assessment
- [DeployHQ MCP Server](https://www.deployhq.com/features/deployhq-mcp.md): Model Context Protocol server for Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf
- [Deployment Availability](https://www.deployhq.com/features/deployment-availability.md): Per-project and account-wide deployment windows — block deploys during incidents, change freezes, and maintenance
- [Deployment Checks](https://www.deployhq.com/features/deployment-checks.md): Gate every deploy with pre-build and post-deploy validations — SSH commands, HTTP probes, and vulnerability scans (Trivy, TruffleHog)
- [Deployment Targets](https://www.deployhq.com/features/deployment-targets.md): Configure deployment destinations with DeployHQ
- [Deployment Templates](https://www.deployhq.com/features/deployment-templates.md): Create reusable deployment configs with DeployHQ
- [Deployment Zones](https://www.deployhq.com/features/deployment-zones.md): Deploy from multiple global regions
- [Docker Builds](https://www.deployhq.com/features/docker-builds.md): Build projects using Docker containers
- [One-Click Rollback](https://www.deployhq.com/features/one-click-rollback.md): Instantly revert to a previous deployment
- [Scheduled Deployments](https://www.deployhq.com/features/scheduled-deployments.md): Queue deployments for any date, time, and timezone — ship to production during off-peak windows
- [Server Management](https://www.deployhq.com/features/server-management.md): Run ad-hoc commands, schedule cron jobs, and open an in-browser console on any SSH-reachable server from the project (beta)
- [SSH Deployment](https://www.deployhq.com/features/ssh-deployment.md): Deploy to any SSH-accessible server (VPS, dedicated, or shared hosting) over SSH or SFTP with key-based authentication
- [Turbo Deployments](https://www.deployhq.com/features/turbo-deployments.md): Accelerated file transfers for faster deployments
- [Zero Downtime Deployments](https://www.deployhq.com/features/zero-downtime-deployments.md): Deploy without service interruption with DeployHQ
- [Team & Permissions](https://www.deployhq.com/features/team-permissions.md): Role-based access control with three permission layers (account, project, server) and Teams on Business and Enterprise plans
- [Single Sign-On](https://www.deployhq.com/features/sso.md): Enterprise SAML 2.0 SSO with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Auth0, and any SAML-compliant IdP
- [Static Site Deployment](https://www.deployhq.com/hosting/static.md): Deploy static sites to Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, DigitalOcean Spaces, and S3-compatible storage
- [API](https://www.deployhq.com/features/api.md): RESTful API for programmatic access to DeployHQ
- [Integrations](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations.md): Connect DeployHQ with third-party services

## Integrations
- [Bugsnag](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/bugsnag.md): Error tracking integration
- [Cloudflare](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/cloudflare.md): CDN integration
- [Codebase](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/codebase.md): Post deploy notes back to Codebase tickets and projects
- [Deployment Notifications](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/deployment-notifications.md): Push deploy status to GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket
- [Discord](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/discord.md): Chat notifications and alerts
- [Google Chat](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/google-chat.md): Card-formatted deploy notifications in Google Chat spaces
- [Honeybadger](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/honeybadger.md): Error monitoring integration
- [HTTP](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/http.md): Signed HTTP webhook for custom dashboards and integrations
- [Linear](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/linear.md): Auto-create Linear Releases in your release pipeline on every deploy
- [Microsoft Teams](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/microsoft-teams.md): Microsoft Teams chat integration
- [New Relic](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/new-relic.md): Performance monitoring integration
- [Rollbar](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/rollbar.md): Error tracking integration
- [Sentry](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/sentry.md): Error monitoring integration
- [Slack](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/slack.md): Chat notifications and alerts
- [Telegram](https://www.deployhq.com/features/integrations/telegram.md): Deploy alerts via Telegram bot — chats, groups, or channels

## CLI & AI Agents
- [Agent Install (deployhq.ai)](https://deployhq.ai): Agent-first landing page — fastest path for AI agents to install and configure the DeployHQ CLI. Serves Markdown to agents, HTML to browsers.
- [CLI & Agents](https://www.deployhq.com/agents.md): AI agent deployment platform — works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline
- [Agent Skill](https://www.deployhq.com/agents/skill.md): Downloadable skill that teaches your AI agent to install the dhq CLI and deploy, roll back, and manage servers — a .skill bundle for Claude (claude.ai and Claude Desktop) and an AGENTS.md build for OpenAI Codex
- [CLI Documentation](https://www.deployhq.com/support/cli.md): Command line interface reference and usage
- [Install CLI](https://www.deployhq.com/install/cli): One-line CLI installer script
